assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry is performed with CPT 93229
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The procedure is medically necessary to evaluate recurrent syncope and near-syncope episodes in this patient with documented cardiac disease
The procedure directly addresses the clinical concern of undetected arrhythmias or ischemia
The missing precertification is identified by CO-197
